description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/VirtualAssistants/Invite. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Sends a single-use, seven-day email invitation; a changed email or reinvitation withdraws previous access until acceptance. ownerAgent: account-metrics. Use when: Invite a new VA, enable a historical profile, change the verified recipient or resend an invitation. Input: Optional profile Id, Name, Email, Stores with exact owned ChannelOAuthId and permission codes, Language. Output: Saves the relationship and sends the email; never sets or returns a password. Search terms: virtualassistants invite. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.
